name: button
description: Debounced button input with press-state and click-event detection. Uses internal state machine with debounce_delay (default 10ms).

constructor_params.name: pin
constructor_params.description: machine.Pin instance (driver auto-configures as input with pull-up/down)

methods.name: is_pressed
methods.description: Returns True if button is currently held down (debounced). Continuously True while held.

methods.name: is_clicked

parameters.name: min_interval
parameters.description: Minimum interval between clicks in ms (debounce for click events)

methods.description: Returns True ONCE per complete press-release cycle. Must be polled at least every debounce_delay ms.

example:
from machine import Pin
from button import Button
from time import sleep_ms

btn = Button(Pin(4))
while True:
    if btn.is_clicked():
        print('Clicked!')
    sleep_ms(50)
esp32_notes: Driver auto-configures pull-up or pull-down based on pin — for typical low-side buttons (button to GND), pull-up is used
is_clicked() depends on is_pressed() being polled — must call in loop faster than debounce_delay
Use only one of is_pressed() or is_clicked() in the same loop — mixing them can cause missed events
hardware_notes: S-V-G wiring: Signal→GPIO, V→3.3V, G→GND (with internal pull-up enabled)
Active-low wiring (button between GPIO and GND) is the standard for ESP32
differences_from_standard_mp: Standard machine.Pin.value() returns raw, possibly bouncing state. Button adds hardware debounce.
is_clicked() detects a complete press-release cycle — standard code requires manual state tracking
